blocker.detail: _snapshot_recorded_source_paths reconstructs REPO / recorded path and calls only final-component lstat/read. It never applies the strict containment and resolution rule, so an ancestor directory symlink can escape or alias the repository while the final target remains regular.
blocker.decisive_counterfactual: With two safe recorded lexical strings routed through aliased ancestors to exact-byte targets and matching Git observations, source identity comparison and current Git custody can both pass because strict-source calls and resolve calls are zero.

additional_component_findings: Initial collection reads an existing out-of-repository or ancestor-symlink target before eventual rejection because _regular precedes containment and strict resolution.
Normalized duplicate spellings return the first original Path, so raw helper output depends on input order even when downstream relative rows match.
The retained contract wording overstates reopen enforcement.

family_reset_requirement.replacement: One shared canonical repository-path admission component used before reads by live collection, sandbox collection, retained reopen, recorded component lookup, and source-evidence lookup.
required_rules: Reject out-of-repository lexical paths before content read.
Require canonical repository root and each strict resolved candidate to equal its normalized lexical path.
Reject final and ancestor symlinks before content read.
Require canonical relative path spelling in retained rows.
Return canonical lexical Paths, not first-seen aliases.
Allow only identical canonical lexical overlaps after every occurrence is independently validated.

expected_later_gate: Current untracked Git custody remains expected and must close only after the complete stabilization suite and zero-blocker holistic review.
